items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Joe Green had a lot to do with it. Because Joe wrote the tune, "Soothe Me," and I supplied the bridge.

ctx.x: That was on a label called Gem, I think. No, it wasn't Gene Norman. Joe Green had a lot to do with it. Because Joe wrote the tune, "Soothe Me," and I supplied the bridge. I didn't get any credit for it, but anyhow, the bridge to "Soothe Me" was by Red Callender.
Oh, that was something of a hit.
